title: meraGEO · Map your brand across AI answers
excerpt: Is AI citing your product? Survey how you appear across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Free visibility score in 30 seconds.
content_html:
Is AI citing your product?1

meraGEO surveys how your brand appears across every major AI assistant, and maps exactly where you're missing.

Then it checks again every week. Models get updated and competitors publish, so what ChatGPT says about you today is not what it said a month ago.

1. Free survey across ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini. No signup required. Results in ~30 seconds.

Scanning stays free, forever, with no signup. What you pay for is the weekly cadence, the history, and the fixes.
